title: Sabbath Rest-Day Protection
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=retreat:event rest_day=yes
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as protected_rest_days by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many intentional rest days were protected each month.
value: Rest days are often crowded out by urgency; counting them makes protection visible and defensible.
implementation: Record intentional rest days in `retreat:event` and trend the monthly count.
visualization: Column chart of protected rest days per month.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It logs how many full rest days you actually managed to protect each month.
